Today, I heard from middle school students in North Carolina about the impact of gun violence on their lives. It is our duty to keep them safe in their classrooms and communities.

President Biden and I passed the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years. But more must be done. Congress must pass red flag laws, make background checks universal, and renew the assault weapons ban.

The students I spoke with understand we need these commonsense reforms — and now, Congress must have the courage to act.
